verdict.rationale: Sunbiz publishes a 'Print & Mail Form' path with downloadable PDF Articles of Incorporation for profit and non-profit corporations, so a documented paper/mail rail exists for at least some formation filings. The evidence gives no mailing address or fax number and no mail form for LLCs or other filings. Missing for 10: the exact mailing address, any fax number or fax filing option, paper forms for LLC formation and other tasks, mail-in fee and payment instructions, and independent corroboration that the mail rail works.

support.subject: As a founder, a paper, fax, or mail fallback rail is published with the exact addresses, numbers, and forms, so the task can still be completed when the online flow is unavailable

citations.quote: Print & Mail Form: Profit Articles of Incorporation (PDF), Non-Profit Articles of Incorporation (PDF)
